definitions.gloss: to spread; to go viral; to share widely (online)
definitions.explanation: To spread information, images, or content widely, especially through social media. In modern usage, often means to repost or share content so it reaches many people.

definitions.gloss: to diffuse; to disperse; to scatter
definitions.explanation: In scientific and technical contexts, the physical process of particles, substances, or energy spreading out through a medium.

notes: Can be used both transitively (⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拡散|かくさん}する, to spread information) and intransitively (⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{拡散|かくさん}する, information spreads). The online sense (sense 1) has become very common in daily usage — {拡散希望|かくさんきぼう} (please share/RT) is frequently seen on social media. In the political/military sense, ⟦{核拡散|かくかくさん}→核拡散：26606_kakukakusan⟧ (nuclear proliferation) and {拡散防止|かくさんぼうし} (non-proliferation) are important terms.
